answer.reason: The verses about Kohath only list him among Levi's sons, give his sons, his age at death and the allotments to his descendants, and tell no deed of his own or event that happened to him beyond what the summary already says.
doubts: NUM 4 and NUM 7:9 describe the duties of the Kohathites as a family, not deeds of Kohath himself.
NUM 16:1 and JOS 21 concern his descendants (Korah, the Kohathite families), not Kohath personally.
